summary.text: Mike Stevens is a Republican state representative from District 18 who took office in January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works as an attorney and chairs the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mike Stevens is an attorney, according to Ballotpedia.
He previously represented South Dakota House District 18 from 2013 to 2019 before returning to the seat in 2021.
In the 2025-2026 session, Stevens chairs the House Judiciary Committee and is vice chair of the House Education Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
